name: Bennett Fracture
definition: Intra-articular fracture-dislocation of the base of the first metacarpal with characteristic volar-ulnar fragment and CMC instability.

investigations.principle: Thumb radiographs define fracture-dislocation; CT is selective for complex articular injury.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, cartilage, tendon, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Displaced/unstable Bennett fractures generally require reduction and fixation.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Angushtha-bhagna phenotype may be documented after modern stabilization.

patientEducation.summary: Intra-articular fracture-dislocation of the base of the first metacarpal with characteristic volar-ulnar fragment and CMC instability.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, severe deformity, progressive weakness, suspected tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
